# Fake Embedder

The FakeEmbedder class generates deterministic 8-dimensional embedding vectors from the content hashes of input texts, primarily used for testing purposes. This allows for verification of the embedding system without relying on actual embedding outputs.

- `knowledge_compiler/llm/embeddings.py` — `knowledge_compiler.llm.embeddings.FakeEmbedder`
